items.titolo: Developer uses AI to bring a native version of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time to iOS — no emulation required to play one of gaming's all-time greats on an iPhone or iPad
items.descrizione: A developer has used OpenAI's Codex and GPT-5.6 Sol to help port a native version of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time to iOS and iPadOS devices.

items.titolo: How to remap the Copilot key on your keyboard to something more helpful
items.descrizione: Pressing the Copilot key on your laptop keyboard launches Copilot. But whether or not you use Microsoft's AI, you can remap the key to trigger a different feature.

items.titolo: Google Docs diventa più intelligente: Gemini crea grafica senza uscire dal documento
items.descrizione: Gemini crea immagini, diagrammi e infografiche direttamente in Google Docs.

items.titolo: Silicon Valley’s Next IPO Billionaires Are Coming. Nonprofits Are Ready for Them
items.descrizione: Anthropic and OpenAI employees are expected to give generously after their companies go public. “It’s going to be a wild ride,” says one nonprofit leader.
